title: 第1章 想结婚不如考虑我第2章 不如把三年前的事做了
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第1章想结婚，不如考虑我？“我说纪少，今天可是你和唐凝登记的日子，你不去，就不怕她生气？”
“谁不知道唐凝跟狗皮膏药一样，就算知道纪少今天是为了宁宁才没去的，她也不敢生气。”
“就是呀，唐凝哪有宁宁重要，纪少打小就疼爱宁宁……”
……
他们口中的宁宁叫纪馨宁，纪寒的挂名妹妹。
唐凝站在酒店包厢门口，感觉浑身血液凝固。
这就是她爱了多年的男人，如此的不堪！
她握紧了拳头，指尖深深地陷入掌心。
可生理上的痛，比不过心理上的万分之一。
她深吸了一口气，推开了门。
砰！
哄闹的包厢，瞬间鸦雀无声。
“唐凝……”众人惊呼。
只见门口的女人肤白貌美大长腿，粉色连衣裙勾勒出完美的腰身，韩式温柔风半扎发，美得惹人魂魄。
可此时她眼神清冷，从纪寒和纪馨宁身上扫过，冷嘲：“纪寒，这就是你没空登记的原因？”
纪寒俊美的脸上闪过一丝心虚，来到她身边，“我们什么时候都能登记，难得宁宁从国外回来，作为二哥，我接风洗尘是应该的。”
唐凝讥笑，“一年才一个恋爱纪念日，这也无所谓吗？”
“难道你不知道，这次不登记就要等到明年？”
这是他们一起说好的。
从恋爱纪念日，转成结婚纪念日，一举两得，意义非凡。

不过很显然，纪寒不想和她结婚。
他真正想娶的人，是纪馨宁。
他的青梅竹马！
可能是察觉到了什么，纪寒又去拉她：“别闹，我回去和你解释。”
唐凝直接甩开了他。
这时，
纪馨宁开口了：“唐凝，对不起，是我不好，我不知道你们今天登记。”。
她低着头道歉，模样委屈，好似被欺负了似的。
唐凝一向厌恶她，没接话。
纪馨宁抬起头，眼里含着泪，是那么的柔弱“唐凝你原谅我，我真心祝福你和二哥的。”
祝福？
content_en:
Chapter 1 If you want to get married, why not consider me? "Master Ji, today is the day for you and Tang Ning to register. If you don't go, aren't you afraid that she will be angry?"
"Who doesn't know that Tang Ning is like a dog-skin plaster? Even if she knew that Master Ji didn't go today because of Ning Ning, she wouldn't dare to be angry."
"That's right, Tang Ning is not as important as Ning Ning. Mr. Ji has loved Ning Ning since he was a child..."
…
Ning Ning in their mouth is called Ji Xinning, Ji Han's nominal sister.
Tang Ning stood at the door of the hotel box, feeling that the blood in her body was coagulated.
This is the man she has loved for many years, so unbearable!
She clenched her fists and dug her fingertips into her palms.
But the physical pain is nothing compared to the psychological pain.
She took a deep breath and opened the door.
Bang!
The noisy box fell silent for an instant.
"Tang Ning..." everyone exclaimed.
I saw the woman at the door with fair skin and beautiful long legs, a pink dress that outlined her perfect waist, and a Korean-style gentle half-tied hair. She was so beautiful that it took your breath away.
But at this moment, her cold eyes swept over Ji Han and Ji Xinning, and sneered: "Ji Han, is this why you don't have time to register?"
A trace of guilt flashed across Ji Han's handsome face and he came to her side, "We can register anytime. It's rare for Ning Ning to come back from abroad. As the second brother, it's my duty to take the wind and wash away the dust."
Tang Ning sneered, "There's only one love anniversary a year. Doesn't it matter?"
"Don't you know that if you don't register this time, you will have to wait until next year?"
This is what they agreed on together.
From a love anniversary to a wedding anniversary, it kills two birds with one stone and is of great significance.
But it's obvious that Ji Han doesn't want to marry her.
The person he really wants to marry is Ji Xinning.
His childhood sweetheart!
Maybe he noticed something, so Ji Han pulled her back again: "Don't make trouble, I'll go back and explain to you."
Tang Ning shook him off directly.
At this time,
Ji Xinning spoke: "Tang Ning, I'm sorry, it's my fault. I didn't know you were registering today."
She lowered her head and apologized, looking aggrieved, as if she had been bullied.
Tang Ning always hated her and didn't answer.
Ji Xinning raised her head, with tears in her eyes, she was so weak, "Tang Ning, please forgive me, I sincerely wish you and your second brother the best."
Blessing?
